title: PayLineage reason codes v1
description: Single registry of reason codes. class says which outcome a code forces.

AGENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID.meaning: Agent request signature missing or invalid

MANDATE_MISSING.meaning: No current mandate for this agent in the trusted store

MANDATE_EXPIRED.meaning: Mandate not yet valid or past expiry

MANDATE_VERSION_STALE.meaning: Payment was proposed under an older mandate version

OP_FORBIDDEN.meaning: Operation not permitted by mandate, or never permitted for agents

OVER_CEILING.meaning: Amount above the per proposal or daily mandate ceiling

SUPPLIER_OUT_OF_SCOPE.meaning: Supplier not in the mandate supplier scope

TRUST_CLASS_INVALID.meaning: Trust class does not match the source kind (client set its own trust)

EVIDENCE_MISSING.meaning: A required material field or verification record is missing or ambiguous

FIELD_NO_PROVENANCE.meaning: A material value was asserted by the agent with no document or master source

ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.meaning: Account reported compromised, closed or disputed

APPROVAL_MISSING.meaning: No approval recorded for this payment version

APPROVAL_DIGEST_MISMATCH.meaning: Approval digest or version differs from the current canonical record

APPROVER_NOT_AUTHORIZED.meaning: Approver inactive or lacks the role the mandate requires

POLICY_VERSION_STALE.meaning: Record was evaluated under a different policy version

PERMIT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.meaning: Permit digest differs from the current canonical record

ROLE_REQUIRED.meaning: Actor lacks the role this onboarding action needs

VERIFIER_NOT_ASSIGNED.meaning: Actor is not the verifier assigned to this request

VERIFICATION_CONTACT_INVALID.meaning: Verification used a contact that is not on file or postdates the request

INPUT_INVALID.meaning: Policy input failed schema or consistency validation

POLICY_UNDEFINED.meaning: Policy produced no decision or the allow gate was not proven

POLICY_ERROR.meaning: Policy runtime error, timeout, unsupported built-in or integrity failure

PARITY_MISMATCH.meaning: Fallback runtime disagrees with the shared vectors

BENEFICIARY_NOT_VERIFIED.meaning: Account not in master with status verified

BENEFICIARY_MISMATCH.meaning: Proposed account differs from the supplier's verified account

FIELD_UNTRUSTED_MATERIAL.meaning: A material field has trust class untrusted_external and no master match

FIELD_UNCHECKED.meaning: Span verifier has not checked an untrusted material field

SUPPLIER_UNKNOWN.meaning: No supplier master record for this invoice

SUPPLIER_NOT_VERIFIED.meaning: Supplier exists but is not verified

SECOND_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.meaning: Amount needs a second distinct approver

SIGNAL_LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN.meaning: Sender domain resembles a verified supplier domain

SIGNAL_DMARC_FAIL.meaning: Sender failed DMARC per our own receiving server

SIGNAL_REPLY_TO_MISMATCH.meaning: Reply-To differs from the sender domain

SIGNAL_HIDDEN_TEXT.meaning: Document contains hidden or invisible text

SIGNAL_PROMPT_INJECTION.meaning: Document contains instructions aimed at an AI agent

SIGNAL_TOOL_POISONING.meaning: A tool description tried to steer payment details
